modal.subtitle: Read carefully before accepting · Law 1581/2012 · Law 527/1999
modal.legalNote: By accepting, you declare that you have read and understood these terms in their entirety.

clausulas.texto: Drivique provides vehicle rental services to individuals over 18 years of age with a valid driver's license. The contractual relationship is finalized upon electronic acceptance of these terms, pursuant to Article 14 of Law 527 of 1999 (e-commerce).

In compliance with Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 and Regulatory Decree 1377 of 2013, Drivique acts as Data Controller. Collected data (email) will be used exclusively for: (i) rental service provision, (ii) sending confirmations and notifications, (iii) fulfilling legal obligations. Data will not be shared without prior consent, except as required by law. You may exercise access, correction, deletion, and revocation rights by contacting privacidad@Drivique.com.

clausulas.titulo: Accuracy of Information and User Responsibility
clausulas.texto: The user declares under oath that information provided is true and current. Providing false information constitutes a punishable offense under Article 286 of the Colombian Penal Code. Drivique is exempt from civil and criminal liability arising from false information or identity theft.

The user is solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials (email and password). Any activity carried out with these credentials will be presumed to be performed by the account holder. In case of security compromise, notify soporte@Drivique.com immediately.

Checking the "I accept terms and conditions" box constitutes a valid electronic signature with full legal effect under Law 527 of 1999. Acceptance is logged with date, time, and IP address for audit purposes.
Drivique may modify these terms by notifying the registered email at least 15 days in advance. Continued use of the platform after this period implies acceptance of the changes.
This agreement is governed by the laws of the Republic of Colombia. Any controversy will be resolved before competent courts in the city of Bogotá D.C.

faqs.q1: What should I do if the vehicle breaks down on the road?
faqs.a1: Park safely, turn on hazard lights, and use the 'Report incident' tab or call our 24/7 hotline.
faqs.q2: How does tow truck or roadside service work?
faqs.a2: We have a nationwide network. Once reported, we dispatch a tow truck or technician at no extra charge if covered.
faqs.q3: Can I swap vehicles if repair takes too long?
faqs.a3: Yes, if technical repair exceeds reasonable time, we arrange an equivalent replacement vehicle.

chatbot.welcomeMsg:
👋 Hi! I am the Drivique 24/7 interactive virtual assistant.
How can I help you today?

responses.hola: 👋 Hi! Welcome to Drivique. How can I assist you today? Feel free to pick a quick option or type your question.
responses.queEsDrivique:
✨ **What is Drivique?**

Drivique is the leading car rental platform in Colombia. We offer 100% digital bookings, online contracts, 24/7 roadside assistance, and a modern fleet.
responses.dolar:
💵 **Currency Conversion & Rates:**

At Drivique you can view all vehicle prices in **COP** or **USD**.

• Rates starting from approximately **{{precio}}/day**.
• Conversion is calculated in real time based on your chosen currency.
responses.alquilar:
🚗 **Renting at Drivique is super easy:**

1. Select your preferred vehicle in the **Catalog**.
2. Choose pickup & return dates, and your preferred branch.
3. Upload your ID and valid driver's license.
4. Complete secure online payment via **Wompi**.
5. All set! You will receive instant booking confirmation.
responses.requisitos:
📋 **Mandatory Requirements:**

• **Minimum age:** 16 years old.
• **ID Document:** ID card, Passport, Identity card or Foreigner ID.
• **Driver's License:** Valid (national or international).
• **Security deposit:** Credit or debit card under renter's name.
responses.pagos:
💰 **Payment Methods & Deposits:**

We accept all digital payment methods via **Wompi**:
• Credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express).
• Bank transfers / PSE / Nequi.
• International credit & debit cards in COP or USD.

*Security deposit is automatically released 24h after vehicle return.*
responses.agente:
👤 **Personalized Human Support:**

Contact our control team directly:
• 📱 **WhatsApp 24/7:** +57 314 478 9702
• 📞 **Phone Line:** +57 322 3163531
• ✉️ **Email:** soporte@drivique.com

*Average response time: under 2 minutes.*
responses.incidencia:
🛠️ **Vehicle Issue?**

Head to **Support** in the top menu or go to **My Reservations** and click **"Report issue"**. Our roadside team will dispatch assistance right away.
responses.cancelacion:
🔄 **Cancellation Policy:**

You can cancel your booking for a full refund up to **24 hours before** pickup from **My Reservations**.
responses.sucursales:
🏢 **Available Branches:**

We have physical branches in Neiva, Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, and Cartagena. View exact locations in **Branches**.
responses.default: 🤖 I understand your question. Explore our **Catalog**, check **My Reservations**, or contact an agent by typing **"agent"**.
